business_and_profit_drivers: Cold-rolled stainless processing is a low-spread commodity business with inventory financing, utilization and raw-material pass-through risks.
9M revenue grew 14.49% to RMB36.136bn while deducted profit grew 14.46% to RMB503.113m: volume/mix improves without decisive margin expansion.
9M CFO RMB322.817m fell 28.41% while cash expenditure on long-term assets reached RMB801.434m: negative RMB478.617m indicative cash conversion.
Overseas capacity can strengthen normalized earnings but only if post-capex cash flow and returns cover funding costs; convertible dilution and historical governance concerns remain.

thesis.core: The September BUY_BELOW RMB21.50 is stale: price 20.47 crossed it but Q3 source evidence warrants fresh conservative underwriting. Positive reported profit growth contrasts with worsening cash generation, high inventory and short-term financing.
thesis.variant_wedge: Use dilutive earnings rather than the prior optimistic basic EPS scenario. At price 20.47 there is no 10-15% valuation buffer on new PW value 18.8625. Crossing an old entry threshold authorizes review, never automatic buy.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: 9M attributable profit RMB524.304m / reported diluted 9M EPS RMB1.33 suggests ~394m implied diluted shares (rounded analytical approximation, not actual issued shares). Q4 scenario profit continuation assumptions imply FY2026 normalized diluted EPS 1.45/1.65/2.10, times cyclically discounted PEs 9.0/11.5/13.0.

verified_financial_facts.prior_year_comparison_restatement: 2025 equivalent earnings and net profit adjusted by company for deferred income tax related to convertible-bond accounting

source_quality_note: Official issuer Q3 PDF direct read and page-2 visual inspection completed: one newly verified official original source, one independently verified 2026-11-18 closing market quote; older business/governance material only carried from preserved Sep-2026 D2 (not re-read). Q3 unaudited; 2025 comparative profit restated; current 2026-11-18 price as of close. FY2026 EPS and 3 scenario multiples are explicit estimates, not company forecast. 9M CFO minus capital cash payments is not normalized free cash flow or capex maintenance split. Diluted share base inferred from rounded EPS.

financial_quality.judgment: Cash conversion weaker than reported profits: CFO/parent NP roughly 62%, inventory +33.5%, receivables +23.5%, short borrowings +15.7% year-to-date; investment intensity delays owner earnings.
financial_quality.governance: Controller judgment and convertibles were covered in preserved September D2, not newly verified; monitor per-share dilution and governance.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: A roughly 12.4x estimated fully diluted cyclically normalized PE with weak free cash conversion does not meet risk-adjusted purchase hurdle.

normalized_earnings_basis.assumption: Q4 earnings/working capital scenario estimates, not management forecast; use reported 9M diluted EPS and Q3 9M cash conversion.

catalysts: Two quarters of improved CFO after capex, normalized inventory and receivables
Overseas project reaches utilization with returns exceeding invested capital cost
2026 audited annual report clarifies sustainable EPS and dilution
kill_thesis: Cash flow cannot cover core maintenance and growth capex as inventory financing grows
Processing spread and overseas projects underdeliver normalized returns
Governance or convertible bond dilutes shareholders economically

capital_comparison.judgment: Old 21.50 price gate invalidated by new underwriting; no trade at 20.47. Review price at <=16.4 or after new verified material cash flow report.

evidence_gap.monitoring: 2026 audited annual statements, maintenance versus growth capex and potential dilution need future verification.
